Housing your teams in Paris, fast and within budget

Short-notice arrivals, tight budgets, dates that move: we know the constraints of non-profit organisations.

What we do for NGOs and organisations

Your team came for a mission, not to hunt for housing. We take care of it.

Fast solutions
A team arriving next week for a conference, a training or an emergency mission: we find and book in time.
Good value
Decent, well-located accommodation at the budget level you give us. No surprises on the invoice.
Well-organised groups
Several people, one neighbourhood, simple journeys to your meeting venue. We manage staggered arrivals.
Clean paperwork
Quotes and invoices itemised per person and per period, ready for your donor reporting.
